text:
Through the mountains you go as the breeze comes…
+Through the
+	mountains you go as the breeze comes
+or the sudden current descending from the
+	snow,
+
+or else your pulsing hair confirms
+the sun’s high ornaments
+	in the thicket.
+
+All the light of the Caucasus falls upon your body
+as into a small
+	endless vessel
+
+where water changes its dress and its song
+with each transparent
+	movement of the river.
+
+Through the mountains runs the old road of warriors,
+and below, enraged,
+	water gleams like a sword
+
+between ramparts of mineral hands,
+until suddenly you receive from
+	the forests
+
+the branch or lightning-flash of blue flowers
+and the strange arrow of
+	a wild fragrance.

translation.title: One Hundred Love Sonnets: XVIII — Through the Mountains You Go (Alternate Witness)
translation.editorial_note: The source catalog mislabels this textual witness as Sexual Water; the body is Love Sonnet XVIII with an added first-line heading, retained here and correctly identified.
